3fc94063871bd370.description: Control Now is a London-based RegTech firm focused on solving one of regulation's most persistent challenges: transaction reporting that is accurate, reliable, automated, cost-efficient, and built to adapt as the rules evolve. Since 2017, we've helped banks, brokers, asset managers, and hedge funds replace fragmented manual processes with reporting infrastructure they can trust, reducing both operational risk and cost. Our platform, Control Box, supports a diverse, high-quality client base across multiple regulatory jurisdictions. It transforms reporting from a reactive compliance burden into a controlled, auditable operational capability. Designed around automation, transparency, data integrity, and traceability, the platform gives firms clear visibility into what is being reported, why, and how, helping compliance become an embedded business process rather than a latent source of regulatory risk. Behind the technology is a team with more than two decades of hands-on experience in regulatory reporting and financial markets infrastructure. We've worked directly with the operational, technical, and regulatory challenges our clients face, and that practical experience informs every aspect of the business, from product architecture and regulatory logic through to implementation and client support. Role Description Control Now (CN) are looking for a Product Manager / Owner to manage the analysis, specification, and delivery of CNs no code platform Control Box and TRAC. Control Box is a powerful data transformation platform which transforms client trade data into regulatory reports. It operates from an easy-to-use interface designed for intricate workflows and eliminates the need for development and testing teams to manage change to regulatory reporting solutions. TRAC is the backend engine that processes data using transformation logic configured within Control Box. It includes a desktop tool that can be executed locally, enabling secure data processing without the need to share data outside the server environment. Prior to the introduction of Control Box, many Control Now solutions were developed directly on TRAC. As a result, several legacy solutions continue to operate exclusively on the TRAC platform. Key Responsibilities The Product Manager /Owner for Control Box and TRAC will be responsible for the execution, delivery, and continuous improvement of Control Box and TRAC. The role requires a strong combination of business analysis, data expertise, and cross-functional collaboration. Product Delivery & Execution Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of product features from concept through to releaseTranslate product roadmap items into detailed epics, user stories, and acceptance criteriaWork closely with dev to ensure timely and high-quality deliveryAct as the primary point of contact for product-related queries during development Business Analysis & Product Specification Interpret product features and regulatory requirements and translate them into clear functional and technical specificationsEnsure all requirements are documented with sufficient detail, including edge cases and validation scenarios Client Engagement & Support Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for Control Box and TRAC in client interactionsSupport client onboarding, training sessions, product demonstrations, and workshopsManage and resolve client queries related to data, logic, and product functionalityGather and prioritise client feedback to inform product improvements Testing & Quality Assurance Own business testing (UAT) for new features and enhancementsEnsure high product quality, minimising defects and rework Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with QASupport Sales with product demos and technical explanationsCollaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless product adoption and delivery Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to improve product user experience, product functionality and performanceProactively suggest enhancements to improve client experience, scalability and automation.Contribute to the evolution of product processes and best practices Documentation & Knowledge Management Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date product documentation, including specifications and release notesEnsure knowledge is documented and transferable to support scalability and team collaboration This role is a Product Manager / Product Owner hybrid with a strong emphasis on business analysis, data transformation, client engagement, and delivery execution. Reporting Line Reports into the Head of Product .

Job Title: Product Manager Omnichannel CX Platform

Package: 10 lpa

Location: Mumbai (But involves extensive travel within & outside Mumbai)

Reports to: Lead - Business Development

Experience: 5--8 years (Product Management / SaaS / CX-Tech domain)

About the Role:

A fresh omnichannel CX platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of the product from co-creation through to market launch, revenue generation, and P&L accountability. This is a high-autonomy, high-accountability role for someone who can operate as both a product builder and a business owner. You'll work closely with the development team to shape the product, then personally drive its go-to-market strategy, build and lead a sales team, and be accountable for revenue outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Product Co-Creation (Pre-Launch)

- Partner with the development team to define and evolve the product roadmap

- Gather and synthesize customer feedback to inform feature prioritization

- Conduct ongoing competitor analysis to maintain differentiation

- Track emerging technology trends (AI, automation, omnichannel tooling) relevant to CX platforms

- Translate market needs into clear product requirements and specifications

• Go-to-Market & Lead Generation (Post-Launch)

- Identify, evaluate, and liaise with marketing agencies to design and execute lead generation campaigns

- Own positioning, messaging, and launch strategy for the product

- Monitor campaign performance and iterate on GTM approach based on results

• Sales Team Build-Out & Revenue Ownership (Scale)

- Recruit, build, and lead a dedicated sales team

- Define sales processes, targets, and enablement materials

- Own the P&L for the product line revenue targets, cost management, and profitability

- Report progress and strategic decisions to Directors while operating with full autonomy on execution

Required Qualifications

- 5 to 8 years of experience in product management, ideally within SaaS, CX-tech, or B2B software

- Demonstrated experience taking a product from development through commercial launch

- Prior exposure to building or scaling a sales function (direct experience leading a sales team is a strong plus)

- Experience working with marketing/growth agencies for demand generation

- Strong analytical skills comfortable owning revenue and P&L metrics, not just product metrics

Key Skills & Competencies

- High ownership mentality comfortable operating independently with minimal oversight

- Strong cross-functional collaboration (engineering, marketing, sales)

- Customer-centric mindset with strong synthesis skills (feedback roadmap)

- Commercial acumen understands unit economics, CAC/LTV, sales pipeline management

- Excellent stakeholder communication, particularly upward to Directors

Success Metrics:

- Product launch timeline adherence

- Lead volume/quality generated post-launch

- Sales team ramp-up and revenue attainment vs. target

- Product P&L profitability
